literal: About everyone, everything that happens, at all times, swiftly knowing is the king's duty.
translation: It is the king's duty to swiftly know everything that happens to everyone at all times.
modern: நாட்டில் உள்ள எல்லாரைப் பற்றியும் நிகழும் எல்லாவற்றையும் எப்போதும் விரைந்து அறிந்துகொள்வதே ஆட்சியாளரின் கடமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core responsibility of a ruler regarding intelligence gathering. The phrase 'எல்லார்க்கும் எல்லாம் நிகழ்பவை' emphasizes that no person or event is exempt from the ruler's awareness. 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்' means at all times, showing that vigilance must be continuous. The word 'வல்' can mean strongly or swiftly; here it means swiftly, stressing that the ruler must know things immediately to act before situations escalate.
